sections.summary: Go Workflow Stack kan substantiële opdrachten omzetten in een zelfstandig deelbaar HTML-overzicht met scope, bewijs, beperkingen en provenance zonder GitHub-toegang.
delivered_scope: Decide the standard stakeholder output contract
Choose the publication and access model
Prototype one portable HTML delivery package
Add the versioned delivery manifest contract
Build deterministic standalone HTML and manifest output
Enforce disclosure scans and immutable release versions
Document and package the shareable delivery workflow
excluded_scope: Automatische publieke hosting zonder expliciete publisher-adapter

evidence.label: Decide the standard stakeholder output contract
evidence.summary: summary=Accepted versioned stakeholder delivery contract; changed_files=.go/decisions/events.jsonl,.go/tasks/active/shareable-output-contract.json; verification=python3 cli/go.py validate . plus readback rc=0; critic=approved contract separates narrative from structured provenance and keeps HTML derived

evidence.label: Choose the publication and access model
evidence.summary: summary=Accepted portable-first publication model; changed_files=.go/decisions/events.jsonl,.go/tasks/active/shareable-output-publication.json; verification=python3 cli/go.py validate . rc=0; critic=approved build and publish boundaries are separated and no GitHub access is required

evidence.label: Define redaction and disclosure boundaries
evidence.summary: summary=Accepted fail-closed disclosure model; changed_files=.go/decisions/events.jsonl,.go/tasks/active/shareable-output-privacy.json; verification=python3 cli/go.py validate . rc=0; critic=approved unknown disclosure defaults to restricted and publication remains gated

evidence.label: Define generation and release lifecycle
evidence.summary: summary=Accepted immutable delivery lifecycle; changed_files=.go/decisions/events.jsonl,.go/tasks/active/shareable-output-lifecycle.json; verification=python3 cli/go.py validate . rc=0; critic=approved explicit releases avoid accidental publication and preserve superseded history

evidence.label: Prototype one portable HTML delivery package
evidence.summary: summary=Built and browser-reviewed standalone stakeholder delivery prototype; changed_files=.hermes/prototypes/shareable-output/index.html,.go/decisions/events.jsonl,.go/tasks/active/shareable-output-prototype.json; verification=prototype contract script plus browser DOM overflow probe rc=0; critic=approved visual hierarchy readable and directly forwardable with six mandatory sections and no internal scaffolding

evidence.label: Add the versioned delivery manifest contract
evidence.summary: summary=Added go-workflow.delivery.v1 JSON schema and fail-closed manual validator with RED-GREEN tests; changed_files=schemas/delivery.schema.json,go_workflow/cli.py,tests/test_smoke.py,.go/tasks/active/delivery-schema-contract.json; verification=python3 -m pytest tests/test_smoke.py -q rc=0 138 passed plus validate and diff-check rc=0; critic=approved schema and validator cover mandatory stakeholder sections release disclosure and provenance with precise missing-section error

evidence.label: Build deterministic standalone HTML and manifest output
evidence.summary: summary=Implemented deterministic delivery build CLI producing standalone HTML and adjacent manifest from one epic; changed_files=go_workflow/cli.py,tests/test_smoke.py,.go/tasks/active/delivery-build-cli.json; verification=python3 -m pytest tests/test_smoke.py -q rc=0 139 passed plus delivery build help validate and diff-check rc=0; critic=approved deterministic rebuild hashes HTML escaping standalone asset-free output and six stakeholder sections

evidence.label: Enforce disclosure scans and immutable release versions
evidence.summary: summary=Enforced fail-closed disclosure scans immutable release versions supersedes validation and explicit publisher adapter boundary; changed_files=go_workflow/cli.py,tests/test_smoke.py,.go/tasks/active/delivery-disclosure-lifecycle.json; verification=python3 -m pytest tests/test_smoke.py -q rc=0 143 passed plus validate and diff-check rc=0; critic=approved sensitive findings do not echo matched content restricted remains usable and released output cannot be silently changed

evidence.label: Document and package the shareable delivery workflow
evidence.summary: summary=Documented no-GitHub delivery workflow disclosure lifecycle output contract and fresh-fixture packaging proof; changed_files=README.md,CHANGELOG.md,tests/test_smoke.py,.go/tasks/active/delivery-docs-packaging.json; verification=bash scripts/check-linux.sh rc=0 144 passed validate and template pairing ok plus diff-check rc=0; critic=approved docs match implemented defaults paths failure modes and immutable lifecycle

limitations: De eerste release ondersteunt één epic per delivery
Restricted output kan interne details bevatten en is niet automatisch publicatieklaar
next_steps: Configureer alleen indien nodig een expliciete hostingadapter met passende toegang en revocation
